findings.description: Select the explicit cause using an `is not None` check. Using `or` discards a cause whose exception class defines false truthiness.
findings.rationale: If an exception subclass implements `__bool__` to return False, `raise TryAgain() from FalsyError()` outside an except block sets a valid cause but no context. This expression evaluates to None, so reraise() raises TryAgain instead of the underlying FalsyError; when context exists, it can instead raise the wrong exception.
